$comment: TEMPORARY (plans/xorgate-device-simulator, Phase 2). Namespaces the agent already applies that the backend's generated `config-contract.json` does not carry yet, written here EXACTLY as `npm run contract:generate` in backend/xorgate-core-service is expected to emit them once Agent B registers the namespace. The contract test merges this file over the generated artifact, and asserts that none of these keys is ALREADY in the generated file — so the moment B's regenerate lands, this test fails with 'remove the addition' and this file is deleted. Never add a namespace here that the worker does not apply.

simulation.description: Device-simulator scenario selection (`simulation` namespace). Accepted only for devices created as simulated; a simulated device replays the catalog scenario `scenarioId` from `demo-assets/v1/`, parks for `gapSeconds` between laps, and loops while `loop` is true. Applied live by the replay source (5 s settings poll, and forced on every cloud config message); a changed scenarioId ends the current lap in place.

scenarioId.description: Catalog id of the scenario to replay (demo-assets/v1/<scenarioId>/).

loop.description: Replay the scenario again after the parked gap; false parks at the end of the lap until changed.
